text_block_list.name: Pottery Teacher
text_block_list.text: Pottery reflects creator's heart. Secret to crafting fine piece is understanding own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: My own feelings……well……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, Trainer-san! I'll put my whole heart into making it!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――Brand new mug for Trainer-san!
Started few days ago. Was taking breather during race research……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ――Trainer-san's mug is so nice～. Handle looks like horseshoe!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Feels so warm too…… Ah, is it handmade?
I nodded, looking at mug in hand. Handmade, yes, but just old school project.
choice_data_list: Yeah, I took a pottery class
Yeah, I took a pottery class

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Hmm～ you had classes like that? How lovely～! ……Um, can I take look?
Felt slightly embarrassed, but handed mug over. Then――
(Buzzzzz)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eek! B-b-b-bug! A bug?!
(Slip――CRASH!)

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm so sorry! I was so clumsy, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Can't make exact replica……but! I'll make something just as wonderful, I promise!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: First, horseshoe handle is must. Two-tone color scheme. Turf and dirt tones, then……
Kind offer, plus rare chance to try pottery, so we joined workshop.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Something like this……I think.
Maybe Rhein Kraft had craft knack. Barely hour in, shape already looking great.

text_block_list.name: Pottery Teacher
text_block_list.text: My, my. Quick worker, little lady～. Quite skilled too～. Smooth form, even thickness.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much! ……Though.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ――Starting over from scratch!
Before I could blink, she crushed clay flat. Already looked better than mine, yet……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Thinking bigger volume might be nicer. Keeps you fueled while working!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Clay shrinks when fired! Gotta make it extra big! Hnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Ah, wait. Too big makes it clumsy to hold, right? Grip needs to feel comfortable……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Alright! Adding subtle curve for finger grip! ……Hnnnngh!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Handle……horseshoe shape. Not too heavy, not too slim, comfortable fit…… Hmmm～ maybe bit large……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Color, color, color…… Hmmm, turf glaze here……dirt tone here……no, maybe this one! Handle color……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Phew~~! It's doooone————! Trainer-san, look! How is it?

text_block_list.name: Pottery Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hehe, quite passionate effort～. ……Firing takes about month and half. Look forward to finished piece～.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yay!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Wait…………month and half……?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: No waaaay～～～! How did I totally forget about firing time～?!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I…… I wanted it to be ready for you soon…… and now it's going to take a whole bunch of time～…… Aww.
choice_data_list: It's not going to take that long

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Trainer-san……
choice_data_list: You put so much effort in to it, right?
You put so much effort in to it, right?

text_block_list.text: She spent so much time adjusting the size and shape for comfort. Rhein Kraft remade it so many times just for that.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: You're right. The feelings…… at least those, I put in lots and lots!
And besides――more than that.
choice_data_list: I could see how much you cared about it
I could see how much you cared about it

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Eh? How much…… I cared?
She asked, and I answered. For example, how she spent hours spinning the clay focusing on the size and shape……
How she kept working with the clay, with a purpose. Unwavering, determined. Silently forging ahead, just like……
choice_data_list: Just like a true craftsman, it was shocking

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Shocking……

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I see…… shocking, huh…… ehehee.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Yeah, thank you very much! ……………………Nfufuu.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Waa～ no way! I don't get told that very often so I couldn't help smiling! My cheeks just keep tensing up……!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: ……Haaa. Geez～, Trainer-san.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: It feels like my cheeks are melting…… Ehe.
